title: Score Mismatch and Set-Constrained Sampling in Zero-Shot Conditional Discrete Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.21061v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Discrete diffusion models have become a powerful framework for modeling complex discrete distributions across a range of applications. While theoretical convergence guarantees depend on consistency between the target and training distributions, such a case rarely holds in practice, making score mismatch a central challenge in discrete diffusion sampling. This is particularly relevant to zero-shot conditional generation, where a model trained on the unconditional distribution is directly reused at inference time to sample from a conditional target distribution. In this paper, we provide the first theoretical analysis for score-mismatched discrete diffusion models and derive a general KL divergence upper bound that clearly identifies the additional bias caused by such a mismatch. Our analysis covers partial-observation constraints, including text infilling, sentence completion, and more general coordinatewise set constraints. Specificall

translated_title: 零样本条件离散扩散中的分数失配与集合约束采样
translated_abstract: 离散扩散模型已成为在众多应用中建模复杂离散分布的强大框架。尽管理论收敛保证依赖于目标分布与训练分布之间的一致性，但这种情况在实践中很少成立，这使得分数失配成为离散扩散采样中的核心挑战。这一问题在零样本条件生成中尤为突出，即在推理阶段直接将在无条件分布上训练的模型重用于从条件目标分布中采样。本文对分数失配的离散扩散模型提供了首次理论分析，并推导出一般的KL散度上界，该上界清晰地刻画了由这种失配引起的额外偏差。我们的分析涵盖了部分观测约束，包括文本填充、句子补全以及更一般的逐坐标集合约束。
tldr: 本文首次对分数失配的离散扩散模型进行了理论分析，推导出一般的KL散度上界来量化失配造成的额外偏差，并覆盖文本填充、句子补全等部分观测约束场景，为零样本条件生成提供了理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first theoretical analysis of score-mismatched discrete diffusion models, deriving a general KL divergence upper bound that quantifies the additional bias caused by the mismatch, covering partial-observation constraints such as text infilling and sentence completion for zero-shot conditional generation.
